The four tables list every atom of one conventional cubic cell of four crystals (files named by crystal). Use the kinematic structure factor with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights and first-order Bragg diffraction; the relevant peak is the lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity. Weights: sodalite: Al = 13, Cl = 17, Na = 11, O = 8, Si = 14; Buckminsterfullerene: C = 6; MOF-5: C = 6, H = 1, O = 8, Zn = 30; Ni O: Ni = 28, O = 8. For X-rays of wavelength 1.54056 Å, you must choose the crystal whose lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity lies closest to 2θ = 13.80° (for example, to calibrate a detector at that angle). Which crystal should you choose?

选项：
A. sodalite (COD1000028-cell.txt)
B. Ni O (COD4320505-cell.txt)
C. Buckminsterfullerene (COD9011073-cell.txt)
D. MOF-5 (COD1516287-cell.txt)

附件：COD1000028-cell.txt、COD9011073-cell.txt、COD1516287-cell.txt、COD4320505-cell.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：常规晶胞按 CIF 全部对称操作展开（task_families/cell.py）；周期晶体；衍射题为运动学模型与原子序数权重。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
